title: confed config result
description: The `result` of `confed config --json`. Its shape follows the flag: `--list` (the default) every setting and where its value came from; `--get` one setting; `--set` and `--unset` the change made; `--set rules_page_id` the page copied into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, or {"cancelled": true} when the picker is left; `--no-keychain` and `--force-keychain` where the credential is now stored.

source.description: Where the value came from, in order of precedence: a flag, the environment, the stored config, a prompt, the built-in default.

entries.description: Every setting, the username and token included.

flag.description: The command-line flag that sets it.

env.description: The environment variable that sets it.

value.description: Null when unset; `***` for a secret.
As stored. For rules_page_id, the page id.

title.description: rules_page_id only, once the page has been pulled: its title.

path.description: rules_page_id only, once pulled: the page's workspace-relative path.

version.description: rules_page_id only, once pulled: the version copied.

agent_docs.description: rules_page_id only: the agent contract files rewritten (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md); empty when they already carried it.
rules_page_id only: the agent contract files its rules were removed from.

credential_store.description: Where the credential is now: the OS keychain, or `.session.db`.

previous.description: Where it was, when it moved.

changed.description: False when it was there already. --force-keychain with no keychain available leaves it in sqlite, with a warning.
